title: Code and data for "Fusion of local-resonance and Bragg band gaps in periodic resonator arrays"
description: MATLAB and Python code that reproduces the figures, tables, and computed values of the manuscript "Fusion of local-resonance and Bragg band gaps in periodic resonator arrays" by M. Carrillo-Munoz, B. Sharma, and J.-S. Chen, with the plotted data of every computed figure and the transcripts of the verification scripts. The code is released under the MIT License; the figure data files (figures/data) are released under CC BY 4.0.
